fact: On 22 July 2025 the Finance Ministry installed 5 heads of service, 7 project heads and 6 assistants at its Direction des systèmes d'information, including ACSI engineers, as project heads of SFEC, SIPAE, SIGFIP, SIVL and SYSPACE.
title: Direction des systèmes d'information (DSI) du Ministère des Finances
publisher: Ministère des finances, du budget et du portefeuille public
